reviewer: Claude (Opus 5), 2026-10-02. Each value was translated back to English without the English original in view, then compared for meaning: a dropped clause, an inverted negation, a lost "instead". Two fixes came out of it — es accountRecipients.privacy.ownAccounts gained "En cambio" for English's "instead", and ja receive.privacy.publicAddress gained "いずれかの" for "one of your Seedelfs". NO NATIVE SPEAKER HAS READ THESE. That is the accepted risk (post-release roadmap, open question 2); a user who reports an error is the feedback loop working.
